title: What if humans shrank to the size of ants overnight?

beats.text: What if every human on Earth shrank to the size of an ant overnight?
You wake up at seven. Your pillow is a mountain, and the edge of your bed is a cliff as tall as a skyscraper.
So you jump. And you survive. At this size, the air slows you down so much that falling barely hurts.
Your cat wakes up too. To you, it's as tall as the Eiffel Tower. And it just noticed something moving.
The walk to the kitchen is now a ten kilometer hike, through a forest of carpet.
The good news? One grain of rice could feed you for months.
The bad news is water. Surface tension turns a single drop into a trap you can't climb out of.
Nobody can open a door, drive a car, or fly a plane. By noon, every city on Earth goes silent.
And you're not alone down here. There are two and a half million ants for every human. Now, they're your size.
Then the sky turns dark. Every raindrop weighs fifty times more than you.
Your only shelter is a leaf. Welcome to the ants' world.
Would you survive the first day? Tell me in the comments.
